## Description

An `EDGE_CURVE` bounding a face has only its 3D curve populated; no parametric (pcurve) representation accompanies the edge on its host surface. Many writers strip pcurves entirely or fail to compute them per-face. Receivers that assume every edge-on-face has a pcurve dereference null and crash; receivers that tolerate the absence must reconstruct the pcurve themselves by projecting the 3D curve onto the surface.

## Reproducer recipe

`EDGE_CURVE` references a 3D `LINE`/`B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS` and bounds an `ADVANCED_FACE`; the corresponding `SURFACE_CURVE.associated_geometry` lacks any `PCURVE` entry. With STEP writer flag "Write out curves in parametric space of surface" enabled but no cached pcurve.

## Expected kernel behavior

synthesise the missing pcurve by projecting the 3D curve onto the host surface, or reject the input as malformed. Never dereference a null pcurve handle.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject, heal`
